notes.title: Droste Effect - PATCH 1.01
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

An update for the full game has been released. In this patch we fixed a bug that caused the pocket watch images to disappear and the non-activation of the radar after opening the menu and inventory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44826620/8a3fdb7b8ccc54803e8cf6a00ab54789636fb061.png[/img]

This made it difficult to figure out where to use it. 

To fix the bug in your save you need to do one of the following:

     1. If you already have another equipable, equip that one and then re-equip the watch

     2. If you don't have another equipable, then you can:
         - Restart from a save before picking up the watch
         - Click the [b]1[/b] button (button to equip the watch) and then open the menu or inventory




Thank you for your support.

notes.title: RELEASE ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.notes:
Dear players,

We are thrilled to announce that[b] Droste Effect[/b], our new 2D adventure and puzzle game, is now available for FREE on Steam! After so much hard work, we are finally ready to share this experience with all of you.

[b]What is Droste Effect?[/b]
[i]Droste Effect[/i] is an engaging 2D puzzle game with survival horror elements created with RPGMaker XP. Step into the shoes of Alexandra as you explore the mysterious past of her new home, uncover hidden secrets, and face increasingly complex puzzles. In this intense adventure, you'll have to manage your sanity while rediscovering the power of memories.
Will you be able to escape the past and reclaim your present?

[b]Join the Community[/b]
Want to discuss theories, share your progress, or give feedback? Join us on our [url= https://discord.gg/7MUA5M7tsX]DISCORD[/url] channel! We are always ready to listen to your suggestions to further improve the experience.



Thank you again for your support, and… have fun with Droste Effect!

With love,
The ParasomniasGames Team.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2720070
